title: Footer Settings
description: Everything from the Contact section to the bottom copyright line. These are global elements shown on every page. Menu items for the footer are in Appearance > Menus.

fields.label: Eyebrow label
fields.name: contact_eyebrow
fields.instructions: Small uppercase label above the heading.

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: contact_heading
fields.default_value: Ready to talk about your project?

fields.label: Subheading
fields.name: contact_subheading
fields.default_value: No pitch. No pressure. Just a 30-minute conversation to see if we're the right fit.

fields.label: Contact form shortcode
fields.name: contact_form_shortcode
fields.instructions: Paste the shortcode for the form (e.g. from Gravity Forms). Example: [gravityform id="1" title="false" description="false"]. Leave blank to hide the form column.

fields.label: Footer logo
fields.name: footer_logo
fields.instructions: Optional. Light or reversed variant since the footer background is dark. Leave blank to use the Brand text.

fields.label: Tagline
fields.name: footer_tagline
fields.default_value: Architecture grounded in how you live.
fields.instructions: Shown under the brand in the footer.

sub_fields.label: Icon
sub_fields.name: icon
sub_fields.instructions: Click to choose a social icon.

fields.label: Copyright suffix
fields.name: footer_copyright
fields.instructions: Appended after the auto-generated year and brand name. HTML links are allowed. Example: All rights reserved. Made by GruffyGoat.
